comparisons.reason: Different constructs. Feature 0 needs a comment to refute (argue against or debunk) a specific OP example or anecdote in the body. Feature 1 needs only that a comment quotes or references any specific OP text element, and endorsement or disagreement is not required. A quote or reference is not a refutation, and feature 1 covers any phrase, claim or sentence rather than only examples. The empty-list rules also differ: feature 0 returns 0 for an empty list, while feature 1 returns null.
